title: Build Your Own ISP
subtitle: Grow a neighborhood network into a resilient, traffic-engineered service provider.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: First Customers
chapters.description: Bring the first LAN online, segment customers safely, and connect their gateways.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Regional Backbone
chapters.description: Replace hand-built paths with OSPF and BGP as the network expands across regions.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Managed Services
chapters.description: Protect customers, translate edge traffic, and carry tenant networks across the fabric.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Provider Core
chapters.description: Build the labeled core, survive failures, reserve capacity, and steer exact paths.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Network Operations
chapters.description: Operate application-aware WAN paths and restore every service during a compound outage.
